radius.$description: Corner radius of the default media frame.

radius-md.$description: Corner radius of the medium media frame.

fallback-bg.$description: Solid fill behind the image and fallback symbol.

fallback-bg-image.$description: Optional background image over the media fill.

fallback-backdrop-filter.$description: Complete filter applied behind the media surface.

fallback-icon-size.$description: Inline and block size of the unavailable-image symbol.

fallback-icon-stroke-width.$description: Stroke width of the unavailable-image symbol.

caption-gap.$description: Space between the image frame and its caption.

caption-fg.$description: Text colour of the visible caption.

caption-font-size.$description: Type size of the visible caption.

caption-line-height.$description: Line height of the visible caption.
